message: A round of grocery and pantry fixes. Finish shopping now offers price fields and freezer toggles for everything in your cart, not just the last item checked. Adding a recipe to the list no longer risks a crash. Merging two items keeps everything you'd recorded on both, and renaming an item can be undone. A packet in the freezer counts as having it everywhere, so the app stops asking whether you still have it. Receipt prices are recorded against the amount on the receipt, small-pack barcodes (UPC-E) now scan, and the Reminders sync no longer duplicates items like "milk x2".
